{{[[{{ns:Template}}:{{{1|Tlx}}}|{{{1|Tlx}}}]]{{#if:{{{2|}}}|<code>&#124;</code>{{{2}}}}}{{#if:{{{3|}}}|<code>&#124;</code>{{{3}}}}}{{#if:{{{4|}}}|<code>&#124;</code>{{{4}}}}}{{#if:{{{5|}}}|<code>&#124;</code>''etc.''}}}}<noinclude>{{Top|fprot}}
----
Usage: {{Tlx|Tlx|template name|first parameter|...}}<br />
Up to three parameters for the specified template are displayed as placeholders, more parameters are shown as "<code>|</code>''etc.''", for details see below.

==Documentation==
{&#123;[[Template:{{PAGENAME}}|{{PAGENAME}}]]&#125;}
is a generalization of {{Tlx|Tl|x}}, {{Tlx|Tlp|x|y}}, etc. with arguably better readable
output. This depends on the browser, but too narrow
uses of "'''{'''", "'''|'''", "'''}'''" in conjunction
with links can be hard to read.

===Usage===
:<code>{&#123;{{PAGENAME}}|template name&#125;}</code>
:<code>{&#123;{{PAGENAME}}|template name|param&#125;}</code>
:<code>{&#123;{{PAGENAME}}|template name|1|2|3&#125;}</code>
:<code>{&#123;{{PAGENAME}}|template name|1|2|3&amp;#124;more&#125;}</code>
:<code>{&#123;{{PAGENAME}}|template name|param&amp;#61;value&#125;}</code>
''Up to three placeholders for parameters of the specified template''

===Example===
{| border="1" cellpadding="4" class="wikitable"
! Code
! Result
! Remark
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor}}
||&#160;
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|one}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|one}}
||&#160;
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|one|two}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|one|two}}
||&#160;
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|1<code>&#124;</code>2<code>&#124;</code>3}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|1|2|3}}
||&#160;
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|1<code>&#124;</code>2<code>&#124;</code>3|4}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|1|2|3|4}}
|up to 3 parameters
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|1<code>&#124;</code>2<code>&#124;</code>3&amp;#124;4}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|1|2|3&#124;4}}
|align="right"|<code>&amp;#124;</code> for more
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|x&#61;u}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|x=u}}
|'''=''' won't work
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|x&amp;#61;u}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|x&#61;u}}
|align="right"|<code>&amp;#61;</code> is okay
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|&lt;nowiki&gt;x&#61;u&lt;/nowiki&gt;}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|<nowiki>x=u</nowiki>}}
|align="right"|sticky nowiki is okay
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|&#160;|two}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor| |two}}
|empty won't work
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|&amp;#32;|two}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|&#32;|two}}
|align="right"|<code>&amp;#32;</code> is okay
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|&amp;nbsp;|two}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor|&#32;|two}}
|align="right"|<code>&amp;nbsp;</code> is okay
|-
|{{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor| &amp;#124; two}}
|{{Tlx|Anchor| &#124; two}}
|align="right"|<code>&amp;#124;</code> is okay
|-
|| {{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor| {&#123;!&#125;} two}}
|| {{Tlx|Anchor| {{!}} two}}
|align="right"|<nowiki>{{!}}</nowiki> is dubious
|-
|| {{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|<nowiki>2=</nowiki>|<nowiki>3=two</nowiki>}}
|| {{Tlx|Anchor|2=|3=two}}
|empty really doesn't work
|-
|| {{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|<nowiki>2=one</nowiki>|two}}
|| {{Tlx|Anchor||two}}
|'''two''' clobbers '''2=one'''
|-
|| {{Tlx|Tlx|Anchor|<nowiki>3=two</nowiki>|<nowiki>2=one</nowiki>}}
|| {{Tlx|Anchor|3=two|2=one}}
|align="right"|right to left okay
|}
